notable_absence.finding: Third statement in this batch (with ALTER BUCKET, ALTER GROUP) that is purely management-plane capella-role gated with cluster access credentials explicitly excluded - no Basic/Advanced privilege pair.

cross_component_finding: ALTER BUCKET, ALTER GROUP, and ALTER USER all share an identical Prerequisites paragraph verbatim (same three roles, same 'You cannot execute this statement using cluster access credentials' caution) - these three statements form a clean, uniform sub-family within the management-plane track. This is the strongest signal yet that the two-track model (management-plane capella-role vs. data-plane credential-type) is a stable, deliberate design rather than incidental page-by-page documentation.
